hook: Both 260 kW. $460 apart new. LS-based 6.0 vs Ford's 5.4 Boss. The original V8 war.
cta: VZ SS or BF XR8? Pick a side 👇

stories.a: The new 6.0 L76 brought 10 Nm more and a lighter body. Simple pushrod V8 with an endless aftermarket.
stories.b: Quad-cam, 32-valve Boss 5.4 built in Geelong. Heavier car, but it sipped less on the official cycle.
stories.take: Dead even on power. The comments will decide the rest.

_sources: Carsales research: 2006 Holden Commodore SS VZ Manual MY06 (260 kW @ 5600, 510 Nm @ 4400, 14.6 L/100km, kerb 1654 kg, price new $51,790); Carsales editorial 'Holden Commodore VZ V8 L76 6.0 litre update' (1 Feb 2006) confirms 260/510 and $51,790
Carsales research: 2006 Ford Falcon XR8 BF Manual (Boss 260 5.4 DOHC 32v, 260 kW @ 5250, 500 Nm @ 4000, 13.8 L/100km, kerb 1800 kg, price new $51,330)
